'> Because we want to help you well and quickly, we have listed the most frequently asked questions for you. This way you will find an answer faster, and we take some pressure off our colleagues. Is your question still not listed? Then we will gladly help you by phone. General What is cheaper, renting furniture or buying furniture? Whether renting is cheaper than buying depends on how long you are going to use the furniture. If you choose to rent furniture in combination with KeyPro’s transport and installation service, you won’t have to worry about a thing. All you have to do is select the furniture you need and we will do the rest. This ensures you save a lot of time and won’t get stuck with products you would have bought otherwise. In addition, renting always ensures you have working products for the entire duration of the contract. What is the advantage of renting furniture? When you rent furniture, you pay for the use of it, not for the possession. If you no longer need (certain) products, you can return them. You don’t have to worry about them anymore. Another advantage of renting is that you always get the guarantee that your product works and continues to work. If something breaks, we’ll provide you with a replacement product. This may be the same product or an equivalent alternative. What costs renting furniture? The cost of renting furniture depends on your specific situation. This includes the number of items, the rental period, and the needs of the residents or the project. That is why we work with tailor-made quotations. This way, you know exactly what to expect, without surprises. Simply request a quotation , and we will calculate it for you while also thinking along with you right away. Are the products new or used? The products you rent at KeyPro are new or (young) used. As we think it is a shame to throw away products, we invest in durable furniture which we maintain with the greatest care. This way, you can be sure that you will get a good working product that you can enjoy to the fullest. Deliveries & returns What is the delivery time of rental furniture? The delivery time for our furniture depends on a number of factors, such as the delivery location, how many items are needed, and whether everything is in stock. In most cases, we can deliver and install within 2 to 5 working days after you approve the quotation. Sometimes, a product may be temporarily unavailable in the right warehouse. In that case, we will always offer an equivalent alternative. Would you like to know quickly what is possible? Request a no-obligation quotation , and we will review the options with you right away. Is it possible to pick up or return products in one of your stores? Unfortunately, it’s not possible to collect products yourself. We have our own transportation and installation service that can deliver our products to any location. This way you can be sure that your rented products are transported, placed and installed in the right way. What are the conditions for deliveries and returns? We apply the following conditions for our deliveries and returns: Exemptions, permits, tolls, ferry services, parking costs, removal of traffic obstacles (such as bollards and gates) and related work to arrange/organise this are not included; Parking a maximum of 20 metres from the front door. If parking further than 20 metres is required, a surcharge will apply; The traffic area, in and around the delivery location, must have sufficient space to transport the goods without increasing the risk of damage. There must be at least 10 cm of free space around a product; Spaces must be freely accessible without being hindered by obstacles, people and objects; If we need to wait longer than 15 minutes, a surcharge will be applied. There is also a chance that a new delivery moment has to be scheduled with additional delivery costs; If there is no lift available at the location, products will be delivered up to and including the first floor. For products from the 2nd floor, a surcharge will have to be paid: If a lift is available, it must be suitable for use of goods delivery. It is at all times the client’s responsibility that ordered products can be placed and installed at the correct location without hindrance. If goods do not fit, have to be returned or have to be delivered again as an alternative, the costs shall be borne by the client. Does KeyPro also deliver on weekends or in the evenings? No, we only deliver on weekdays (Monday to Friday) on office hours (from 08:00 to 18:00). Can KeyPro change the delivery date if the planning changes? Of course. We understand that schedules can change. Please inform us in time if anything changes by emailing info@keypro.nl or by calling us. We will quickly arrange a new delivery appointment. What happens to KeyPro’s furnishing when residents change? With a change of residents, you don’t have to worry about anything. KeyPro handles the entire process: if needed, we collect the furniture, ensure everything is thoroughly cleaned, and refurnish the property for the next resident. Everything is done quickly, neatly, and without hassle, so the property is always ready for the next step. Ordering & Payments What is the minimum order value? Rental period Minimum 1 month € 485,00 Per month 2 months € 245,00 Per month 3 months € 175,00 Per month 4 months € 120,00 Per month 5 months € 105,00 Per month > 6 months € 90,00 Per month The transport costs are at least €420, depending on the location where the furniture is to be delivered. All amounts stated are excluding VAT. What does the deposit amount entail? The deposit amount serves as a guarantee for the delivered furniture and depends on the rental value of your order. At the end of the rental period, we will refund the deposit within 14 days, provided that all furniture is complete and undamaged. Normal signs of use and wear are not a problem. You charge transport and installation costs. What does that mean? We have our own in-house transport and installation service. This means that we take care of the entire logistics process, so you do not have to worry about a thing. The costs cover delivery, placement and installation (move-in), as well as de-installation and collection (move-out), and environmental charges. In which way payments can be made? Before delivery, you will receive an invoice. This invoice must be paid before the delivery takes place. Payment can be made via: Bank transfer Payment link (iDEAL or credit card) Credit card payment with the driver upon delivery (only if you have not yet received the invoice) We also offer monthly or project-based invoicing. This is arranged in advance. Termination & renewal What is the notice period at KeyPro? Our standard notice period is 1 month. Not sure about the rental period? Then choose the minimum term you need, after which we will automatically extend it. That way, you remain flexible. Please schedule a collection appointment at least 2 working weeks in advance. Custom arrangements are possible in consultation, and we are happy to think along with you. Can I extend my rental contract? After the agreed rental period, your contract is automatically renewed. This means you can continue renting for as long as you like. How can I cancel my contract with KeyPro? Would you like to cancel? You can do so easily by sending an email to info@keypro.nl (please include the delivery address, the desired contract end date, and when we can collect the furniture). We apply a standard notice period of 1 month. As soon as we receive your message, we will send you a confirmation and schedule the collection. Can I buy furniture from you after the rental period? It is possible to purchase furniture at the end of the rental period. We would be happy to look into the possibilities of buying the furniture from us. Please note that it is not always possible to buy (all) products. When your product is rented again to someone else, we reserve the right not to sell the product. Service requests Where to submit a service request? If something goes wrong or if something has become defective, we are happy to help you. You can use this form to submit a service request to us. We will process your request as soon as possible. Is your question not listed? Please contact us! Furniture rental for sales styling For which homes is KeyPro’s sales styling suitable? Our styling is suitable for any type of home, from compact apartments to spacious family houses and luxury villas. We always tailor the interior to match the style of the property and the target audience you want to attract. This way, you get the most out of the presentation. How does sales styling help with the selling price? A styled home looks more attractive, warmer, and more professional. This leads to more online clicks, more viewings, and a stronger emotional connection during visits. As a result, you often see this reflected in the number of offers and the final selling price. Which spaces are styled in a sales styling project? In principle, we furnish all living areas: living room, dining room, kitchen, bedrooms, bathroom, and hallway. We also include outdoor spaces such as the balcony or garden, as they contribute to the first impression. What if I want multiple homes styled at the same time by KeyPro? No problem. We have experience styling multiple homes simultaneously, even across different locations. We coordinate planning and execution to ensure everything runs smoothly and efficiently. Does KeyPro also provide styling for show homes or showrooms? Yes, we also style show homes, temporary rental properties, and showrooms. Everything is tailored, with attention to appearance, atmosphere, and target audience, even for longer periods. Ordering & delivery of sales styling How does delivery and installation work for KeyPro’s sales styling? On the agreed day, our team arrives with furniture and accessories. We take care of the styling from A to Z: from unloading and placing everything to the final finishing touches. Within one day, the property is ready for the photographer. And once the house is sold, we collect everything again. Can I extend the package with KeyPro if the property has not been sold yet? Certainly. You simply extend it on a monthly basis, starting from €325 including VAT. No hassle, no notice period, just flexibility. How far in advance should I schedule the styling with KeyPro? We recommend contacting us at least two weeks in advance. But need it done quickly? Thanks to our own stock and logistics, we can often move fast, sometimes within just a few days. Furniture rental for expats What is expat furniture rental? Temporary rental of a complete interior for expats, often for 3 to 12 months. How does furniture rental for expats work at KeyPro? We deliver, furnish the space, and collect everything again once the tenant leaves. Can you also rent from KeyPro for short periods (for example, 3 months)? Yes, rentals are possible from as little as 1 month. We tailor everything to the expat’s length of stay. Does KeyPro also provide bed linen, kitchenware, and decoration? Yes, our furnishing packages are complete. Everything from bed textiles to cutlery is included. Furniture rental for accommodation locations What is important when furnishing an accommodation location? Think of safety, hygiene, multifunctional furniture, and fast installation. KeyPro provides complete tailor-made furnishing solutions. How quickly can an accommodation location be furnished by KeyPro? Within 5 working days, including delivery, setup, and installation. Can KeyPro’s furnishing be adapted to different family compositions? Certainly, we furnish according to each family situation: 1, 2, 3, or 4 persons. We can also adapt the furnishing for larger groups and for specific needs, such as elderly people, children, or residents with reduced mobility. Can KeyPro also deliver to large locations in one go? Yes, we specialize in large-scale deliveries for municipalities and asylum reception centres. Is it possible for KeyPro to deliver in phases? Yes, we align the planning with your needs and delivery dates. Furniture rental for housing corporations Can KeyPro’s furnishing be tailored to specific residents (families, elderly, people with disabilities)? Yes, it can. We tailor the furnishing for each project to the residents. Upon request, we adapt the interior for children, elderly people, individuals with reduced mobility, or even for pets. What if a temporary housing unit needs KeyPro’s furniture for a longer period? That’s no problem. If a project lasts longer than expected, we simply adjust the rental period. You can email info@keypro.nl with the updated dates and schedule a new collection appointment. What if damage to KeyPro’s furniture occurs during the rental period? As a tenant, you are required to report any damage, defects, or malfunctions to us. Within 48 hours of receiving a report, we will arrange for repair or replacement, unless this cannot reasonably be expected of us. All related costs (such as cleaning, repairs, and transport) will be charged to the tenant. For more details, please refer to our general terms and conditions . Sustainability & Partnerships What does KeyPro mean by “sustainability” and how do you apply circular reuse? At KeyPro, sustainability means extending the lifespan of furniture. Our furniture is reused multiple times, lasts for years, and saves raw materials. That’s exactly where the greatest CO₂ reduction is achieved with furniture. On our Circular Furniture page , you can read more about this. How does KeyPro contribute to chain collaboration and partnerships? We believe impact is greater when you work together. That’s why we collaborate with municipalities, housing corporations, companies, and partners such as Circulair Groningen en Drenthe to achieve sustainable and social goals. What does “responsible entrepreneurship” mean at KeyPro? Responsible entrepreneurship means working transparently, choosing local suppliers, ensuring safe working conditions, and organizing our logistics as sustainably as possible, for example, using emission-free vehicles. We safeguard this through our certifications . How does KeyPro make an impact on both the environment and society? We combine environmental benefits with social value. With circular furniture rental, we reduce CO₂ emissions, while through social return and community projects we create opportunities for people who are distanced from the labor market. Social Impact & Collaboration What does Social Return mean for KeyPro and which projects do you support? Social Return means that we actively contribute to employment opportunities for, among others, permit holders and people with a distance to the labour market. In addition, we support projects such as Maggie’s and Adopteer Regenwoud. You can read more about this on our Social Return & Community Projects page . What concrete examples show KeyPro’s impact in practice? Our impact is reflected in a variety of projects: from furnishing temporary homes with circular furniture to setting up collaborations for sustainable procurement. Take a look at our cases and partnerships for inspiring examples. Can I get in touch for more information or a collaboration? Yes, we would be happy to discuss creating impact together. Please contact us via our contact form or call us directly at 085 002 21 10 for more information. Is your question not listed here? furnishing Voerman Group Expat housing International relocations do not always go according to plan. By working with KeyPro, Voerman can now provide expats with a fully furnished temporary solution when their own furniture is delayed. Together, we make the transition smoother and turn an unfurnished property into a practical additional housing option. Read more Multinational ISG Expat housing ISG is an international construction company that has contributed to building some of the world’s most iconic places. A few years ago, they faced a major challenge: furnishing the homes of expats joining ISG. To make this process run more smoothly, they turned to KeyPro. Read more Housing association Wierden en Borgen Housing Association Wierden en Borgen faced a major challenge during one of their renovation and sustainability projects. In such projects, residents often need to temporarily leave their homes, which creates a complex logistical puzzle. To make this process run more smoothly, they brought in KeyPro to fully manage the organization of temporary housing. This allowed the Wierden en Borgen team to focus on other important aspects of the project. Read more Boekholt & Partners Real Estate Home staging Boekholt & Partners Real Estate is an agency focused on the private housing market in Groningen and Assen. Their challenge? Presenting vacant homes in an attractive way to potential buyers—so they could be sold quickly and successfully. KeyPro was tasked with meeting this challenge by providing a complete styling solution with fast delivery. Read more Municipality of Groningen Refugee shelters The Municipality of Groningen faced a complex challenge in setting up a temporary shelter for Ukrainian refugees. The project was marked by many uncertainties and delays, making it difficult for the municipality to complete on time. We were brought in to take care of the full furnishing of the housing units, allowing the municipality to focus on other crucial aspects of the project. Read more Municipality of Hollands Kroon Refugee Shelters We were assigned to furnish 42 apartments for refugees within just four weeks. The challenge? A fast and complete delivery of fully furnished homes, ready to move in from day one. With a tight logistical plan, our own inventory, and flexible service, we made it happen. The result? Comfortable, homely environments where residents can settle in quickly and truly feel at home. Read more Housing Association Lefier Groningen Housing Association Lefier Housing associations in the Netherlands have been tasked with making a huge number of homes more sustainable. “We need to upgrade older energy labels to A, or in some cases B. Ultimately, it’s all about sustainability. But just as important is guiding our tenants through the process. We want to support them as best we can throughout the entire renovation project,” explain Annie and Rina from Lefier. After all, tenants experience a lot of disruption when living in a home that is being renovated. Read more Housing Association Nijestee Housing Association Nijestee As one of the largest housing associations in Groningen, Nijestee regularly carries out renovation and sustainability projects. These projects bring along a lot of work and inconvenience for residents. KeyPro was brought in to fully take care of furnishing temporary rest and guest homes. Thanks to this collaboration, Nijestee was able to offer residents a fully furnished guest home during renovations, where they could stay without any worries. Read more Heijmans ONE flexwoning Model home For the Heijmans ONE project in Putten, KeyPro furnished a complete model home that optimally showcases the possibilities of these innovative flexible homes. The challenge? Quickly create an inspiring and well-thought-out interior design that gives potential residents and stakeholders a realistic impression of the comfort and functionality of this compact living space. Thanks to smart product selection, efficient delivery, and meticulous styling, we transformed the home into a compelling showcase for future living. Our mission Certifications Our Impact Work at KeyPro Our Impact You are here: Home About Us Our Impact What KeyPro Stands For Thoughtful. Sustainable. Shared. Our approach goes far beyond simply delivering furniture. We make conscious choices, work sustainably, and share our impact with others. You can see it in everything we do. From creating circular interiors to providing social employment opportunities. Our Impact Pillars Sustainability Why Second-Hand Is Our First Choice With us, a piece of furniture is never 'finished'. That is when its real story begins. We extend the lifespan of furniture, choose reuse, refurbish whenever possible, and in doing so, reduce our ecological footprint. Partnership & Supply Chain Collaboration We Don't Do It By Ourselves, And That's Exactly the Point Read more about our collaborations. Responsible Entrepreneurship Transparent, Local and Conscious For us, responsible entrepreneurship also means doing business with integrity. We work with local suppliers, choose transparent supply chains, and take responsibility. From CO₂-conscious logistics to safe working conditions. Social Return & Community Projects Business Is About More Than Profit We believe business is also about giving back. From creating jobs for refugees to supporting projects like Maggie's and Adopteer Regenwoud, we use our furniture and our network to create opportunities and make impact. Frequently Asked Questions Sustainability & Partnerships What Does KeyPro Mean by "Sustainability", and How Do You Apply Circular Reuse? At KeyPro, sustainability means giving furniture a longer life. Our pieces are reused again and again, last for years, and save valuable resources. Because that’s where the bigges t CO₂ savings in furniture are found. You can read more about this on our Circular Furniture page. How Does KeyPro Contribute to Supply Chain Collaboration and Partnerships? We believe impact grows when you create it together. That is why we work with municipalities, housing associations, businesses, and partners such as Circulair Groningen en Drenthe to achieve sustainable and social goals. What Does "Responsible Business" Mean at KeyPro? For us, responsible business means working transparently, choosing local suppliers, ensuring dafe working conditions, and organising our logistics as sustainably as possible. For example, with zero-emission vehicles. All of this is secured through our certifications. How Does KeyPro Make an Impact on Both the Environment and Society? We combine environmental gains with social value. Through circular furniture rental, we reduce CO₂ emissions, while social return and community projects create opportunities for people with limited access to the labour market. Social Impact & Collaboration What Does Social Return Mean to KeyPro, and Which Projects Do You Support? Social return means we actively contribute to job opportunities for refugees and people with limited access to the labour market. In addition, we support projects such as Maggie’s and Adopteer Regenwoud. You can read more about this on our Social Return & Community Projects page. Which Concrete Examples Show Your Impact in Practice? Our impact is reflected in a variety of project: from furnishing temporary homes with circular furniture to building partnerships for sustainable procurement. Explore our cases and collaborations for inspiring examples. Can I Get in Touch for More Information or a Partnership? Yes, we’d be happy to discuss how we can create impact together. Get in touch via our contact form or call us directly at +31 (0)85 002 21 10 for more information. Quote request Our mission Certifications Our Impact Work at KeyPro Partnership & Supply Chain Collaboration You are here: Home About Us Our Impact Partnership & Supply Chain Collaboration We Don’t Do It By Ourselves, And That Is Exactly the Point At KeyPro, we believe real change starts with working together. That is why we actively build partnerships that go beyond furniture alone. We join initiatives that make an impact. On people, on the planet, and on the future. Whether it is circular supply chain in Groningen, protecting rainforest in Costa Rica, or creating social employment locally. Together with our partners, we turn every project into something bigger. Below, discover the collaborations that inspire us, and our clients, to make the impossible possible. Circulair Groningen & Drenthe As a partner of Circulair Groningen/Drenthe , we are part of a growing network of entrepreneurs, governments, and organisations committed to building a circular economy. Together, we accelerate the transition by sharing knowledge, learning from one another, and seizing circular opportunities. Protecting Rainforest with Every Project Sustainable furnishing also means being mindful of what we take from the planet. That’s why, at KeyPro, we give something back. For every project we deliver, we protect a piece of tropical rainforest in Costa Rica. We do this together with Adopteer Regenwoud , a foundation dedicated to biodiversity and CO₂ storage. This means your temporary interior automatically becomes an investment in nature. You will even receive an official certificate showing the number of square meters protected thanks to your project. Did you know that 1 m² of rainforest stores an average of 20 kg of CO₂ each year? Read More about Donation Koploper Project: From Waste Stream to Showpiece In the Koploper Project, we work alongside other circular pioneers to build sustainable supply chains. One of the best examples? The circular chain in Euvelgunne, Groningen. From Waste to Showpiece Together with Zwartwoud , NNRD , Provincie Groningen en Circulair Groningen/Drenthe ,we developed a supply chain that transforms local wood and plastic waste streams into furniture with a mission. The first tangible result is a stylish bedside table, made from materials that would otherwise have been discarded. Crafted by people with fewer job opportunities and made available through KeyPro’s rental service for both business and individuals. The very first piece was symbolically presented to René Paas, the King’s Commissioner, who praised the initiative as a prima example of local strength and collaboration. And this is only the beginning. This circulair chain will be further developed in Euvelgunne. What began as an experiment is growing into a new standard, a story that is far from finished. Positieve Impact: Because Doing Good and Doing Business Can Go Hand in Hand Stichting Positieve Impact is a network of companies and organisations that, like us, believe in a world where products have no expiry date. Where reuse becomes the standard. And where collaboration drive progress. Because making an impact doesn’t have to be complicated. As long as you do it together. You Make the Difference Every collaboration brings us closer to a circular future. Curious to see how we can create impact together? Quote request Our mission Certifications Our Impact Work at KeyPro Social Return & Community Projects You are here: Home About Us Our Impact Social Return & Community Projects Business Is About More Than Profit We believe business ia also about giving back. From creating jobs for refugees to supporting projects like Maggie’s and Adopteer Regenwoud, we use our furniture and our network to create opportunities and make an impact. How We Make a Difference: Guidance for refugees , in collaboration with the Municipality of Groningen and others Partnerships with social enterprises for logistics, assembly and maintenance Learning and internship opportunities , in the warehouse, at the office, and on the road Coaching and support, we give people the space and guidance to grow Clear goals, we measure and improve our social impact every year “We don’t just give furniture a second chance, we give people one too” Refugees Visiting KeyPro Recently, we welcomed a group of refugees to KeyPro. All eager to find work. New to the Netherlands, full of ambition, and still in the middle of their integration courses. Through a collaboration with the Municipality of Groningen and the Zuidoost Business Association, they were able to take a look behind the scenes at our company. Not to apply straight away, but to discover what it’s like to work at a Dutch business. Some are still exploring their options, while others are already eager to start in a paid role. Work here is different. Education systems are different. And cultural differences can play a part. That is exactly why this initiative is so valuable: it’s not just about job openings, but about connecting, getting to know each other, and breaking down prejudices. We hope to soon find someone who’s the right fit. Someone we can offer a great place to work, and who wants to help build a sustainable, circular future. This is how we create space for growth. For people and for businesses. Donation to Adopteer Regenwoud During our opening party in April, we raised €3.010 for Adopteer Regenwoud. With this, we have secured 1.204 m² of tropical rainforest in Costa Rica. A beautiful piece of the planet now preserved for future generations. It inspired us to go further. That is why we now make sure every project gives something back to the earth. Together with Adopteer Regenwoud, we protect a piece of tropical rainforest in Costa Rica with every assignment. A tangible and valuable step towards greater biodiversity and lower CO₂ emissions. Read More about Adopteer Regenwoud Our Support for Maggie’s At KeyPro, we hold Maggie’s close to our hearts. Almost everyone knows someone, or has been personally affected, by this devastating disease. Maggie’s offers support, comfort and a listening ear to people with cancer and their loved ones. Something we believe is incredible important. We help in different ways. Sometimes by providing furniture to make their locations feel warm and welcoming. Other times by actively joining projects and challenges to raise funds. Like the annual September Walking Challenge, where we team up with colleagues and partners to collect as many kilometers and donations as possible. Step by step, we work towards a place where people truly feel supported. Frequently Asked Questions About Social Return What Exactly is Social Return? Social return means giving something back to society. For example, by creating job opportunities for people with limited access to the labour market or by supporting community projects. Which Target Groups Does KeyPro Work With? Think of refugees, people have been unemployed for a long time, and those who need extra support to re-enter the workforce. Why Is Social Return Important to KeyPro? Because we believe business is about more than profit. KeyPro wants to add value to society and contribute to a sustainable future. About Our Community Projects How Does KeyPro Decide Which Projects to Support? We choose projects that align with our core values and truly make a difference for people and nature, such as Maggie’s and Adopteer Regenwoud. How Can My Organisation Work with KeyPro We are happy to explore the possibilities. From joint projects to applying social return in tenders. Contact us at +31 (0)85 002 21 10 or via info@keypro.nl. How Do I Know the Impact of My Partnership? At the end of a project, we share the results of your contribution. Such as the number of people supported into work, the square meters of rainforest protected, or other tangible outcomes. Our mission Certifications Our Impact Work at KeyPro Sustainability You are here: Home About Us Our Impact Sustainability Why Second-Hand Is Our First Choice For us, a piece of furniture is never truly ‘finished’. That’s when a new chapter begins. At KeyPro, we do not believe in throwing things away. We believe in passing them on. In making smart choices. And in extending the life of what already exists. We give furniture a second, third or even fourth life. By refurbishing what needs a refresh. By carefully considering what can be used again. And by placing each piece exactly where it makes the most impact: in homes, projects and temporary interiors. Every table, chair or cabinet we reuse saves raw materials, reduces CO₂ emissions, and prevents waste. Without compromising on style or comfort. In fact, you will not see the difference but the planet will feel it. Sustainability at KeyPro Sustainable Business Practices Our new premises are fitted with circular materials and energy-efficient systems. From lighting to heating control. Within our internal processes, we also minimise the waste of resources and energy. Furniture reuse By giving furniture multiple lives, we avoid the CO₂ emissions normally associated with producing new pieces. From raw material extraction to transport and manufacturing. Every time we reuse, it means one less production chain. Transition from Ownership to Use We encourage our clients to rent rather than buy. This prevents overproduction, accelerates reuse, and enables flexible furnishing with fewer resources. Smart Logistics Our smart scheduling and in-house inventory reduce the number of trips, cutting emissions significantly. What We Do: Refurbish and redeploy furniture Manage our own inventory in a circular way Use smart logistics to avoid unnecessary trips Collaborate with circular partners in Groningen and Drenthe ISO 14001 certified, and striving for even greater sustainability. At KeyPro, sustainability isn’t a trend. It is a second nature. Because why buy new, when you can do something good instead? Make a Difference Together Every day, we work with partners who, like us, believe in a sustainable, fair, and circular future. From housing associations and municipalities to social enterprises and regional networks. These collaborations help us to maximise our impact and drive change throughout the supply chain, step by step. Here’s a section of the organisations we’re proud to work with: Read more about our partnerships and supply chain collaborations. Read More Circular Furniture At KeyPro, sustainability isn’t just about choosing beautiful furniture. It’s about extending its lifespan. That is where the biggest CO₂ savings in furniture come from. We work with circular furniture: high-quality pieces that we carefully reuse, refurbish, and redeploy in new projects. This way, we save valuable raw materials, reduce waste, and lower CO₂ emissions. Together, we create interiors that are both stylish and responsible. Without unnecessarily stimulating new products. Our mission Certifications Our Impact Work at KeyPro Sustainable Business You are here: Home About Us Our Impact Sustainable Business Transparent, Local and Conscious At KeyPro, responsible business does not start with lengthy reports or grand promises. It’s about the small choices we make every day. In how we work with people, handle materials, and collaborate with our partners. We do it not because we must. We do it because we believe things can be different. And better. No fuss. Real impact. What We Do (and Why We Do It): Local Chains, Strong Relationships We deliberately choose local suppliers. This means shorter lines of communication, less transport, and genuine collaboration. Transparent Procurement We know what we source. And from whom. No vague origins or hidden impact. Just open supply chains and fair agreements. Safety and Happy Workplaces A safe workplace goes without saying for us. But we go further. Investing in enjoyment at work, personal growth, and the wellbeing of our team. Because it's our people who make KeyPro. Smart Logistics We plan our routes with care, reducing mileage and delivering faster. Environment: Giving Back What We Take from the Earth Responsible business also means: thinking about the impact of everything you use . Not just what you deliver, but how it gets there, how it is made, and what happens to it afterwards. At KeyPro, we make those choices every day. Sometimes big, often small. But always deliberate. Sustainable Use of Materials We choose materials that last longer, have less impact, and – where possible – already have a past. This includes: FSC-certified wood and sustainable textiles Refurbished appliances and reusable accessoires Circular components from local waste streams (such as wood and plastic waste) One example is our bedside table from the Koploper Project: made from recycled wood and plastic, locally produced, and finished by people distanced from the labour market. Smart and Efficient Transport Our logistics are designed with CO₂ awareness in mind. Here’s what that means: Tailored route planning , to combine trips and avoid empty mileage Het Nieuwe Rijden : our drivers are trained in fuel-efficient driving, reducing emissions and wear and tear Use of electric vehicles for deliveries in urban areas We also consciously choose to handle a large share of our deliveries with our own fleet. This way, we keep control over the supply chain, and can continuously optimise it. Request a quote +31 85 00 22 110 Nederlands English Search AMSTERDAM KeyPro B.V. Our mission Certifications Our Impact Work at KeyPro The R-ladder: How to Make a Truly Circular Impact From Refuse to Reuse, and everything in between You are here: Home About Us Our Impact Sustainability R-Ladder Creating Impact, from Refuse to Recover At KeyPro, we believe in second chances (and third, fourth). For furniture, and for the planet. We prefer not tot throw anything away if there’s a better option. We use a smart, circular approach to keep products in use for a longer period of time. Meet the R-Ladder (Ladder of Circular Strategies): a framework of ten strategies to handle products in a smarter, more sustainable, and circular way. The higher you climb, the greater your positive impact. At KeyPro, the R-ladder isn’t just a theory, it is our compass. Not one step, but several at once. We refuse unnecessary purchases, reuse furniture, refurbish pieces, and repair what’s broken. And it works. For our clients, for our warehouse, and for the world around us. Curious what that looks like in practice? Explore each step below. From Model to Mindset: How we Make Circularity Concrete At KeyPro, we look at furniture differently. We don’t see products that are written off after a single use. We see opportunities. Chances to reuse, repair and refurbish. To preserve value instead of throwing it away. The R-Ladder of Circularity guides our approach. It shows how to make smarter use of products, from preventing waste to extending their lifespan to the fullest. That is why we deliberately choose durable furniture made form high-quality materials. Their strength and resilience allow us to refurbish and reuse them again and again, giving each piece a new life time after time. This mindset runs through everything we do. We minimize new purchases. We reuse what we already have. And we make sure furniture is ready for its next chapter, even after a project ends. Because at KeyPro, we don’t just rent out furniture. We keep it moving. Circular. Thoughtful. And simply taken care of. Furniture as a Service, Not a Possession At KeyPro, we believe you don’t need to own furniture to make full use of it. With our Product-as-a-Service model, every piece of furniture gets a new story. It moves from home to home, from project to project. Refurbished and prepared for its next destination each time. For our clients, this means convenience. For us, it means responsibility. We ensure that every item keeps moving, never ending its journey as waste. Together, we close the circle: practical, stylish and endlessly circular. Discover Circular Furniture What Does It Deliver? Our Impact in Numbers Working circularly isn’t about grand plans. It’s about the choices you make every single day. Not buying new, but reusing what’s already there. Not discarding what still has value, but refurbishing, repairing, and passing it on. And that makes a difference: Reuse extends the lifespan of an average piece of furniture by 50%. Reusing just one sofa saves around 115 kg of CO₂ compared to buying new . A sofa that serves in a shelter today can complete a temporary home tomorrow. At KeyPro, furniture isn’t written off after one project. It continues to serve for years. Why is reuse the biggest saver? Because it prevents furniture from being incinerated or thrown away. Especially the burning of foam and plastic components causes high CO₂ emissions. By reusing furniture, you skip that phase entirely. According to research commissioned by Rijkswaterstaat, reusing a sofa can cut CO₂ emissions in half . This means you save not only raw materials, but also a significant amount of emissions. (TAUW, 2022) And we don’t do this alone. “Reuse extends the lifespan and avoids new production. That is exactly where the greatest CO₂ savings lie for furniture.” – CE Delft, 2019 We work together with partners who, like us, believe in a circular future: Circulair Groningen & Drenthe , building a strong regional movement Positieve Impact , an energetic community where we take circular steps together Adopteer Regenwoud , protecting a piece of rainforest with every project we deliver Each partnership strengthens our mission: extending the life of furniture and reducing the burden on our planet. Because circularity is never a solo act, it’s something you achieve together. And every client who chooses KeyPro automatically becomes part of that journey. Read About Circularity Together, We Make The Difference Every chair, table, or cabinet we reuse makes the world a little more sustainable. And the more organizations join in, the greater the impact. Curious how circular furniture could fit into your project? We’d be glad to explore the possibilities with you. Practical, thoughtful, and tailored to what is truly needed. Discover Our MVO-hub Request a Quote Frequently Asked Questions Sustainability & Circularity What Does Circularity Mean at KeyPro? For us, at KeyPro, circularity means that furniture is not written off after a single project but given multiple lives. We reuse, repair, and refurbish. And we only recycle when there is no other option. In doing so, we save raw materials, energy, and waste, while keeping furniture in continuous circulation. How Does KeyPro Apply Circularity in Practice? After each project, KeyPro collects the furniture, inspects and cleans every item, and refurbishes whatever is needed. The furniture is then sent on to its next location, ready for a second, third or even fourth life. What Happens to Furniture That Can No Longer Be Used? If a piece of furniture truly reaches the end of its life, we first check whether any parts can still be reused. Whatever remains is sent for recycling. This way, even the very last piece retains value, and nothing ends up as waste unnecessarily. Partnerships & Social Impact How Does KeyPro Contribute to Social Projects? KeyPro refurbishes furniture in collaboration with local partners, creating employment opportunities for people who face challenges in accessing the job market. Why Does KeyPro Choose Local Partnerships? Because at KeyPro, we believe sustainable impact starts close to home. We work with regional suppliers and partners to reduce transport movements and strengthen the local economy. How Does KeyPro Help Organizations Work More Sustainably? By delivering complete circular interiors, KeyPro makes it easy for clients to achieve their own sustainability goals. Less waste, lower CO₂ emissions, and the reuse of furniture are automatically built into every project. Want To Read More? Our mission Certifications Our Impact Work at KeyPro Circular Procurement You are here: Home About Us Our Impact Sustainability Circular Procurement What is Circular Procurement? In circular procurement, the buyer focuses on products or materials that contain as few primary raw materials as possible and can be reused after their first use. The goal is to avoid further depletion of the earth’s resources and to extend the lifespan of materials. A circular procurement process is an important tool in achieving a circular economy. Why is Circular Procurement So Important? According to the Circularity Gap Report, 70 % of global emissions come from processing and using materials: from extraction and production to use and disposal. At the same time, we consume more resources than the earth can regenerate. That pressure keeps growing, as innovations follow each other at high speed and demand more and more materials. This constant depletion of the planet is simply unsustainable. Many of these resources are also processed in a linear system of producing, using, and then discarding. Think of the fast fashion or fast furniture industries: products made as cheaply and quickly as possible, with low quality, meaning they break easily and are often beyond repair. In Europe alone 11 billion kilos of furniture are thrown away every year . Only 10% of this is recycled, the rest is burned or dumped in landfill. This can and must change. By consciously procuring, using, and reusing products and services, we give the earth time to recover. The shift from linear to a circular economy (produce, use, reuse) is essential, and it requires a change. We’ve grown accustomed to the convenience of throwaway behaviour and the mindset of “oh, I’ll just buy a new one”, without seeing the bigger picture. Reuse calls for a different mindset: from producers, businesses, and consumers alike. At your next purchase, take a closer look at the origin and quality of the product. Does it align with the principles of a circular economy? And instead of buying a piece of furniture, could you perhaps rent it next time? 3 Circular Procurement Models To apply circular procurement in your organisation, you can use different models. These models help you make choices that reduce waste, make smarter use of materials, and extend product lifespans. The right approach depends on your organisation’s internal possibilities and on how open suppliers and partners are to change. Based on these factors, you may apply one or more models. The three circular procurement models are: Product level: This focuses on the sustainability of the materials and the product design itself. Is it made from durable, high-quality materials? Can it be easily dismantled and repaired? Can you trace the origin of the materials through a material passport? Supplier level: This looks at how suppliers can contribute to your circular ambitions. Think of suppliers who provide reused materials, take back products after use, or deliver products that can easily be recycled at the end of their lifecycle. System Level: The most comprehensive approach to circular procurement is at system level. Here you look not only at the product or the supplier(s), but at the entire chain. Could you rent instead of buy? Collaborate with other organisations to share products, make use of residual streams, and stimulate reuse? Where your organisation starts is up to you. If you’re new to circular procurement, it’s often best to begin at product level, learn from there, and then expand into the other models. To make circular procurement more concrete, we describe six practical steps below to help your organisation get started. 6 Steps to Circular Procurement Integrating circularity into your procurement process requires a significant policy shift, and an open mindset. Circular procurement starts with asking the right questions. Where you might once have focused mainly on price, lead times, and quality, you now also ask: Where does this product come from? Under what conditions was it produced? Is it designed for reuse? A circular procurement process consists of the following six steps: 1. Define Your Circular Procurement Vision Start by formulating a clear vision of how procurement will contribute to your organisation’s sustainability goals. Do you want to reduce CO₂ emissions, save raw materials, or prevent waste? A clear vision creates direction and ensures stronger support across the organisation. 2. Analyse Current Procurement Streams To make improvements, you first need insight into what you currently purchase. Which products have a short lifespan, create large amounts of waste, or are difficult, or even impossible, to recycle? These are the key focus areas for your circular procurement strategy. They also present quick wins, allowing you to learn and then expand your efforts further. 3. Choose the Right Suppliers Circular procurement is a collaborative effort. Look for suppliers who offer circular products and services, and who truly prioritise circularity. Examples include renting circular furniture instead of buying, using recycled materials, or providing repair services. Be cautious of companies that use circularity only as a marketing term without real action. 4. Adjust Procurement Criteria As mentioned, you’ll need to ask different questions when purchasing products. This also applies to the criteria you set for them. Require durability, the ability to dismantle and repair, use of secondary materials, and the presence of a material passport, for example. 5. Embed Circularity in Contracts To safeguard circular procurement, make sure to record sustainability agreements in contracts. This could include agreements on product take-back after use, maintenance during the lifecycle, and the availability of spare parts. This ensures your commitments don’t fade over time and provides a solid framework for circular procurement. 6. Monitor and Evaluate It’s essential to measure the results of your efforts. How much waste has been avoided? How much CO₂ has been saved? How many products have been reused? Measuring these outcomes enables accountability and helps shape future improvements. It also makes the results tangible for your whole organisation, increasing involvement and motivation. A valuable tool for tracking circular efforts is an Environmental Aspects Register (MAR), a clear document or system where you record, monitor, and evaluate all environmental aspects of your activities. At KeyPro, we also use this tool to stay on course and make timely adjustments where needed. What Are the Regulations Around Socially Responsible Procurement? For companies, circular procurement is not (yet) mandatory. However, the government increasingly expects organisations to take responsibility, especially in tenders. The public sector itself is required to purchase sustainably and circularly, while also encouraging businesses to follow suit. Examples include guidelines such as MEAT (Most Economically Advantageous Tender) , where sustainability and reuse influence the selection of suppliers. In addition, European legislation such as the CSRD (Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive) will soon require companies to report more thoroughly on their impact. To be well prepared, it’s smart for organisations to start focusing on a more circular way of doing business now. Benefits of Circular Procurement for Your Organisation Circulair procurement isn’t just good for the planet. It’s good for your organisation too: Lower long-term costs: Smarter purchasing saves on replacement, waste processing, and raw materials. Less dependence on scarce resources: By focusing on reuse and recycled materials, you become less vulnerable to price increases or supply issues. Stronger sustainable reputation: Demonstrating social responsibility makes you more attractive to customers, partners, and employees. Better preparation for future legislation: You’ll be ahead of new sustainability requirements, such as CSRD reporting obligations. Innovation and collaboration in the supply chain: Circular procurement encourages new partnerships and smarter product or service models. Tangible contribution to climate goals: By reducing CO₂ emissions and waste, you actively support the transition to a circular economy. The Role of Furniture in Circular Procurement Furniture plays an important role in circular procurement policies. Producing new furniture requires large amounts of raw materials (wood, metal, plastics) and energy. By procuring furniture circularly, this environmental burden can be reduced. High-quality circular furniture also has a long lifespan, making it highly suitable for reuse, refurbishing, and repair, and giving it strong residual value. According to research by Royal HaskoningDHV, commissioned by the Netherlands Environmental Assessment Agency (PBL), there has been growth in sustainable procurement for buildings. However, the facilities category, including furniture, still lags behind. While many municipalities focus on circular procurement in sectors such as construction and infrastructure, furniture is often overlooked. This is a missed opportunity, since furniture has a significant environmental impact and is a relatively easy category in which to apply circular principles. At KeyPro, we believe furniture deserves not just a second, but also a third and fourth life. That’s why we rent out furniture instead of selling it outright. This reduces the need for new production and prevents unnecessary strain on the planet. We also consciously choose strong, timeless furniture built to last. Everything we do is centred around reuse and making the most of what already exists. The diagram shows a schematic representation of KeyPro’s circular furniture chain. Frequently Asked Questions About Circularity What Does Circularity Mean? Circularity means that raw materials, products, and materials are reused for as long as possible, without creating waste. What Is a Circular Product? A circular product is designed to last as long as possible, is reusable, easy to repair or recycle, and generates minimal waste. What Does 100% Circularity Mean? 100% circular means that all materials used in a product are fully reused or recycled, with no residual waste. For example, furniture that is rented out again and again. What Is Linear versus Circular? Linear means products are made, used, and then thrown away. Circular means products are made, used, and reused. What Are the 10 R’s of Circularity? Refuse, Rethink, Reduce, Reuse, Repair, Refurbish, Remanufacture, Repurpose, Recycle, Recover. These ten principles help minimise waste and ensure maximum reuse of materials. About KeyPro What Happens to Furniture After a Rental Period? After inspection, furniture returns to our stock. If an item is damaged, it is repaired or refurbished. Once restored, it is as good as new and ready to be used in new projects. After several ‘lives,’ when a piece can truly no longer be used, its parts are harvested to repair similar items. Any remaining material is then recycled. As a Client, Can I Contribute to KeyPro’s Circularity? Absolutely. By renting furniture instead of buying, you help prevent the use of new raw materials. What Happens to Furniture That Can No Longer Be Rented Out? These pieces often get yet another life through social projects or donations. When that’s not possible, we ensure the materials are responsibly recycled. Are All Furniture Items at KeyPro Circular? Yes. We work exclusively with furniture that is suitable for reuse and refurbishment. This means every piece is strong, repairable, and made from durable materials. Meubelverhuur bij KeyPro Meubelverkoop Je bent op: Home Diensten Meubelverkoop Meubels kopen bij KeyPro Slimme inrichting met een goed verhaal. Bij KeyPro geloven we dat meubels meer verdienen dan één leven. Daarom kun je bij ons niet alleen huren, maar ook kopen. Soms is huren namelijk niet de juiste oplossing. Bijvoorbeeld als je langdurig wilt inrichten, liever zelf eigenaar bent of een vaste locatie hebt. Dan kies je bij KeyPro voor meubelverkoop: een slimme mix van gloednieuwe meubels en jong gebruikte refurbished items . Zo richt je snel, stijlvol en circulair in. Zonder gedoe. Kopen als onderdeel van de circulaire keten Bij KeyPro zijn meubels niet eindig. Veel items uit ons verkoopassortiment zijn eerder ingezet in tijdelijke inrichtingen, zoals short-stay appartementen, wisselwoningen of opvanglocaties. Na gebruik worden ze zorgvuldig gecontroleerd, gereinigd en waar nodig opgeknapt. Zo zijn ze weer klaar voor een volgende bestemming: bijvoorbeeld als vaste inrichting in jouw vastgoedportefeuille, kantooromgeving of projectlocatie. Naast hergebruik bieden we ook nieuwe meubels aan: tijdloos design, robuust en geproduceerd met oog voor mens en milieu. ideaal voor langdurige inzet, met minimale onderhoudskosten en maximale betrouwbaarheid. Wat het extra interessant maakt: zelfs na aankoop kunnen we meubels, indien gewenst, terugnemen voor hergebruik in de keten. Zo verklein je je ecologische voetafdruk en voorkom je onnodige afvalstromen. Of je nu kiest voor refurbished of nieuw, bij KeyPro weet je zeker dat je bijdraagt aan een circulair model waarin meubilair blijft circuleren. Slim, duurzaam en doordacht. Bekijk ons koopaanbod Wat je kunt verwachten Een mix van nieuw & refurbished Gloednieuwe meubels gecombineerd met zorgvuldig opgefriste items uit eerdere projecten. Visueel nauwelijks te onderscheiden, maar wel beter voor je footprint en budget. Compleet inrichten, zonder omkijken Van zitbank tot bed. Van witgoed tot raamdecoratie. Alles wat nodig is voor een complete inrichting. Geleverd, geplaatst en gebruiksklaar opgeleverd. Circulair en kostenefficiënt Refurbished meubels verlengen de levensduur van bestaande producten en voorkomen onnodige verspilling. Dat is niet alleen duurzaam, maar ook vriendelijk geprijsd. Onze service bij meubelverkoop Bij KeyPro geloven we in korte lijnen en duidelijke afspraken. Daarom heb je altijd een vast aanspreekpunt voor jouw project, van aanvraag tot oplevering. Wel zo efficiënt. We leveren snel, uit eigen voorraad, en stemmen de planning zorgvuldig met je af. Inclusief een heads-up één uur van tevoren, zodat je nooit voor verrassingen staat. Op alle koopproducten geldt standaard één jaar garantie. En heb je specifieke wensen of een inrichting met extra eisen? Dan denken we graag mee in een passende, doordachte oplossing. Dat is de kracht van samenwerken. Benieuwd naar het aanbod? Of je nu één woning wilt inrichten of een compleet project start, we denken graag met je mee. Laat ons weten waar je naar op zoek bent, dan kijken we samen naar een oplossing die past. Slim, snel en circulair geregeld. 📞 Bel of mail gerust. We staan voor je klaar. Neem contact op Meer lezen? KeyPro Thoughtful interiors, built to last. At KeyPro, we believe furniture should have more than one life. That’s why we offer both rental and sales solutions. In some cases, purchasing furniture is the better option. For example, when furnishing a space for the long term, when ownership is preferred, or when working with a fixed location. Our furniture sales offering combines new items with high-quality refurbished pieces. A practical and sustainable solution that allows you to furnish quickly, professionally, and with minimal effort. Purchasing as a part of the circulair chain At KeyPro, furniture does not have an end of life. Many of the items in our sales collection have previously been used in temporary settings, such as short-stay apartments, transitional housing or emergency shelters. After use, each piece is carefully inspected, cleaned and – where needed – refurbished. Ready for a new destination, like a long-term home in your property portfolio, office space or project location. In addition to reused furniture, we also offer new pieces: timeless in design, built to last, and manufactured with respect for people and the planet. Ideal for long-term use, with minimal maintenance and maximum reliability. What makes it even more sustainable: if desired, we can take back furniture after use, giving it a second life and keeping it in the circular loop. This helps reduce your ecological footprint and prevents unnecessary waste. Whether you choose refurbished or new, with KeyPro you’re investing in a circular model that keeps furniture in motion. Smart. Sustainable. Considered. Discover our sales selection What To Expect A mix of new & refurbished Brand-new furniture combined with carefully refreshed pieces from previous projects. Visually almost identical, but better for your footprint and your budget. Fully furnished, no hassle From sofas to beds. From appliances to window coverings. Everything you need for a complete interior. Delivered, installed and ready to use. Circular and cost-efficient Refurbished furniture extends the lifespan of existing materials and prevents unnecessary waste. A sustainable choice, and a budget-friendly one too. Our Service for Furniture Purchases At KeyPro, we value short lines of communication and clear agreements. That’s why you will always have a dedicated point of contact, from initial request to final delivery. Efficient and personal. We deliver quickly from our own stock and coordinate planning with care. You’ll receive a heads-up one hour before delivery, so you’re never caught off guard. All purchase items come with a standard one-year warranty. Do you have specific needs or furnishing requirements? We are happy to think along and provide a tailored, well-considered solution. That is the power of working together. Curious About Our Collection? Whether you’re furnishing a single property or managing a larger project, we’re here to help. Let us know what you’re looking for, and we’ll work with you to find a solution that fits. Smart, fast, and circular. Just the way it should be. 📞 Feel free to call or email us. We are ready to assist. Contact us Do you want to read more? Klaar voor de volgende huurder. Een woning die altijd klaar is voor de volgende stap. Dat is wat onze schoonmaakservice je oplevert. Wij zorgen dat de woning schoon, verzorgd en representatief blijft. Of het nu gaat om een snelle opfrisbeurt tijdens de verhuur, of een deep clean na vertrek van een huurder. Wij zorgen dat het geregeld wordt. Zo hoef jij niets te regelen met extra partijen. Alles onder één dak. Daarom kies je voor onze schoonmaakservice: Ruim 14 jaar ervaring in tijdelijke bewoning We kennen de verhuur praktijk van binnen van en buiten. Zo weten we precies wat een woning nodig heeft tussen twee huurders in, en hoe we jou het beste kunnen helpen. Volledige ontzorging, één aanspreekpunt Wij regelen de schoonmaak als onderdeel van je meubelverhuur. Geen losse leveranciers of extra afstemming. Jij hebt één planning en één contactpersoon. Wel zo overzichtelijk. Flexibel in te plannen, ook op korte termijn Tussentijdse schoonmaak nodig? Of snel een woning opleverklaar maken? We denken met je mee en zijn snel inzetbaar, waar in Nederland je ook zit. Persoonlijk voorstel, zonder gedoe We houden het graag simpel. Meubelverhuur bij KeyPro Meubels, internet en TV in één keer geregeld? Wij fixen het. Je bent op: Home Diensten Internet en TV Internet en TV Een woning opleveren zonder internet of televisie? Niet ideaal. Zeker niet als de huurder er direct in moet. Daarom regelen wij, naast meubels en stoffering, ook internet en tv. Je hoeft niets zelf aan te vragen. Wij zorgen dat alles werkt, netjes wordt aangesloten en op tijd klaarstaat. En wil je echt geen omkijken naar de administratie? Dan nemen we zelfs de betaling aan de provider voor je over. Alles op één factuur, overzichtelijk geregeld. Waarom je internet en TV via ons regelt: Internet en TV zonder gedoe Aansluiting én installatie via ons geregeld. Eén aanspreekpunt, geen losse leveranciers. Onderdeel van het totaalpakket Combineer met meubels, stoffering of schoonmaak. Alles afgestemd, alles tegelijk geleverd. Op tijd geregeld We hebben 14 dagen nodig voor de aanvraag. Te laat? Dan schakelen we alsnog snel met een monteur. Eén overzichtelijke factuur Geen losse nota’s van Ziggo. Je ontvangt één verzamelfactuur via KeyPro. We’ll take care of it from start to finish You are here: Home Services Home upholstery Window and Floor Coverings Furnishing a home takes more than just furniture. Without flooring or window coverings, a space can feel empty and unfinished. That’s why we also take care of the finishing touches, from curtains to vinyl floors. Whether you need roller blinds, blackout curtains or laminate flooring: we offer expert advice, deliver quickly and handle professional installation. You tell us what’s needed, we take care of the rest. Just let us know what you’re looking for. We’ll create a tailored quote based on your needs, and take care of the entire process from start to finish. Why Choose KeyPro For Window And Floor Coverings? Over 14 years of experience in temporary housing We know what works in a furnished rental home: functional, neutral and with just the right atmosphere. Fully taken care of, from first advice to final fitting You tell us what you need, and we handle the rest: measuring, delivery, and professional installation. No loose ends, just one clear plan. Can be combined with furniture and cleaning Prefer to have everything arranged in one go? We seamlessly coordinate window and floor coverings with furniture rental and cleaning: one plan, one team. Tailored to the home and its residents From blackout curtains to low-noise vinyl floors, always matched to the type of property and the people who will live there. Discover Our Furniture Rental Finishing Touches That Make All The Difference The first impression of a home is all in the details. Furniture sets the shape, but curtains and flooring create the atmosphere. Without window coverings – or with a cold, bare floor – a home can feel empty and impersonal. That’s why we pay close attention to finishing. With neutral tones and practical materials, we create calm, comfort and a homely feel, without overwhelming the space. Just right. Circulair inkopen Je bent op: Home Over ons Onze impact Duurzaamheid Circulair inkopen Wat is circulair inkopen? Bij circulair inkopen focust de inkoper zich op producten of materialen die zo min mogelijk uit primaire grondstoffen bestaan en na het eerste gebruik weer opnieuw gebruikt kunnen worden. Dit met het doel om de aarde niet verder uit te putten en de levensduur van grondstoffen en materialen te verlengen. Een circulair inkooptraject is een belangrijk middel om tot een circulaire economie te komen. Waarom is circulair inkopen zo belangrijk? Volgens het Circularity Gap Report komt bijna 70 % van de wereldwijde uitstoot voort uit het winnen, verwerken en gebruiken van materialen. Tegelijkertijd gebruiken we meer grondstoffen dan de aarde kan herstellen. Door te blijven produceren, gebruiken en weggooien in een lineair systeem, raken grondstoffen uitgeput. Denk aan de fast fashion of fast furniture industrie: snel geproduceerd, lage kwaliteit en korte levensduur. In Europa wordt jaarlijks 11 miljard kilo aan meubels weggegooid . Slechts 10% daarvan wordt gerecycled. De rest wordt verbrand of verdwijnt op de vuilnisbelt. Dat kan en moet anders. Met circulair inkopen geef je producten een tweede (of derde, vierde) leven. Zo voorkom je verspilling, verminder je CO₂-uitstoot en geef je de aarde de kans om te herstellen. Hergebruik vraagt om een andere mindset, van zowel producten, bedrijven en consumenten. Kijk bij de volgende in- of aankoop eens goed naar de afkomst en de kwaliteit van het product. Is dit in lijn met de circulaire economie? En kan je in plaats van een meubel kopen wellicht de volgende keer meubels huren ? De overstap naar een circulaire economie De overstap van lineair naar circulair vraagt om een andere mindset. Niet alleen bij bedrijven, maar bij iedereen die inkoopt of gebruikt. Vraag jezelf bij elke aankoop af: Waar komt dit product vandaan? Hoe lang gaat het mee? Kan het gerepareerd of hergebruikt worden? En misschien nog wel de belangrijkste vraag: moet ik dit kopen, of kan ik het ook huren ? 3 circulaire inkoopmodellen Afhankelijk van hoe ver jouw organisatie is met duurzaam inkopen, kun je kiezen uit drie circulaire inkoopmodellen. Ze helpen je om slimmer met grondstoffen om te gaan en verspilling te verminderen. Productniveau : Focus op het product zelf. Is het gemaakt van duurzame materialen? Kan het uit elkaar worden gehaald of gerepareerd? Heeft het een materiaalpaspoort dat inzicht geeft in herkomst en recyclebaarheid. Leveranciersniveau : Kies voor leveranciers die circulair denken. Leveranciers die producten terugnemen na gebruik, hergebruikte materialen nemen of onderhoudsdiensten aanbieden. Systeemniveau : De meest complete aanpak. Niet alleen naar het product of de leverancier kijken, maar naar de hele keten. Denk aan circulair aanbesteden, huren in plaats van kopen of samenwerken met andere organisaties om hergebruik te stimuleren. Tip: Start op productniveau, leer ervan en schaal op naar systeemniveau. In 6 stappen circulair inkopen Een stappenplan circulair inkopen helpt je om circulariteit te integreren in je inkoopproces. Het vraagt om verandering, maar het levert ook veel op. Een circulair inkoopproces bestaat uit de volgende 6 stappen: 1. Bepaal de circulaire inkoopvisie Formuleer hoe jouw organisatie met inkoop bijdraagt aan duurzaamheidsdoelen. Wil je CO₂ reduceren, grondstoffen besparen of afval minimaliseren? Een duidelijke visie creëert richting en draagvlak. 2. Analyseer de huidige inkoopstromen Krijg inzicht in wat je nu inkoopt. Welke producten zorgen voor veel afval of zijn moeilijk te recyclen? Deze analyse laat ien waar de quick wins liggen. 3. Kies de juiste leveranciers Circulair inkopen doe je samen. Werk met leveranciers die echt circulair werken, niet alleen op papier. Denk aan: Circulaire meubels huren in plaats van kopen Producten van gerecyclede materialen Reparatie- of terugname garanties 4. Pas je inkoopcriteria aan Stel nieuwe eisen aan wat je inkoopt: Levensduur Herstelbaarheid Gebruik van secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden Beschikbaarheid van materiaalpaspoort 5. Leg afspraken vast in contracten Zorg dat circulariteit wart op wit staat. Leg afspraken vast over de terugname, onderhoud en beschikbaarheid van onderdelen. Zo voorkom je dat duurzame intenties verwateren. 6. Monitor en evalueer Meet de resultaten van je circulaire inkoopbeleid. Hoeveel afval is voorkomen? Hoeveel CO₂-uitstoot bespaard? Bij KeyPro gebruiken we hiervoor een Milieuaspectenregister (MAR), een systeem dat inzicht geeft in impact en voortgang. Dit helpt ons om op koers te blijven en de nodige aanpassingen op tijd door te voeren. Regelgeving en maatschappelijk verantwoord inkopen (MVI) Voor bedrijven is circulair inkopen nog niet wettelijk verplicht, maar de overheid stimuleert het actief. Bij aanbestedingen speelt duurzaamheid steeds vaker een rol. Belangrijke richtlijnen zijn onder andere: MEAT (Most Economically Advantageous Tender): duurzaamheid en hergebruik tellen mee bij gunning. CSRD (Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive): verplicht rapporteren op milieu-impact. Door nu al circulair in te kopen, ben je beter voorbereid op toekomstige wetgeving en vergroot je je kansen bij aanbestedingen. De voordelen van circulair inkopen Circulair inkopen is niet alleen goed voor de aarde, maar ook slim voor jouw organisatie: Lagere kosten op de lange termijn, omdat je slimmer omgaat met wat je al hebt en minder uitgeeft aan vervanging of afvalwerking. Minder afhankelijk van schaarse materialen. Je bent minder kwetsbaar voor prijsstijgingen of leveringsproblemen, doordat je inzet op hergebruik en gerecyclede materialen. Sterkere duurzame reputatie. Je laat zien dat je bewust onderneemt, wat vertrouwen wekt bij opdrachtgevers, partners en medewerkers. Beter voorbereid op nieuwe wetgeving. Met circulair inkopen voldoe je sneller aan richtlijnen zoals MVI en CSRD. Meer innovatie en samenwerking in de keten. Circulair inkopen brengt organisaties samen en stimuleert vernieuwende product- en dienstmodellen. Een tastbare bijdrage aan klimaatdoelen. Door minder CO₂-uitstoot en afval lever je direct een positieve impact op het milieu. Over de circulaire keten De rol van meubilair bij circulair inkopen Meubilair is een vaak vergeten, maar grote kanshebber binnen facilitair circulair inkopen. De productie van meubels kost veel grondstoffen en energie. Toch worden miljoenen meubels na kort gebruik weggegooid. Door te kiezen voor circulaire meubels kun je direct impact maken: minder productie, minder afval, meer hergebruik. Uit onderzoek van Royal HaskoningDHV blijft dat circulair inkopen in de bouw toeneemt, maar dat meubels daarbij nog achterblijven. Zonde, want meubels zijn juist perfect geschikt voor circulaire principes zoals refurbishing, hergebruik en huurconstructies. Bij KeyPro geloven we dat meubels niet eindigen, maar opnieuw beginnen. Daarom verhuren we meubels in plaats van ze te verkopen. Zo verminderen we verspilling, verlengen we de levensduur van producten en maken we circulariteit tastbaar in de praktijk. Circulaire meubelketen in beeld In onderstaande visual zie je hoe de circulaire meubelketen van KeyPro werkt: van ontwerp en gebruik tot refurbish, reiniging en herinzet. Elke stap is ontworpen om de levensduur te verlengen en afval te minimaliseren. Klaar om circulair in te kopen? Of je nu werkt bij een gemeente, woningcorporatie of vastgoedbedrijf. Elke organisatie kan vandaag beginnen met circulair inkopen. Bij KeyPro helpen we organisaties om hun duurzame ambities om te zetten in tastbare resultaten. Van circulaire inrichting tot compleet circulair inkooptraject: samen maken we het concreet. Onze meubelverhuur Veelgestelde vragen Algemeen Wat houdt circulariteit in? Circulariteit betekent dat grondstoffen, producten en materialen zo lang mogelijk hergebruikt worden, zonder afval te creëren. Wat is het verschil tussen circulair inkopen en duurzaam inkopen? Duurzaam inkopen richt zich op het beperken van negatieve impact op mens en milieu. Circulair inkopen gaat een stap verder: het voorkomt afval en houdt materialen in de kringloop. Alles draait om hergebruik, levensduurverlenging en het minimaliseren van verspilling. Waarom is circulair inkopen belangrijk voor bedrijven? Omdat het helpt om toekomstbestendig te ondernemen. Je vermindert CO₂-uitstoot, verkleint je afhankelijkheid van grondstoffen en voldoet sneller aan duurzaamheidswetgeving zoals de CSRD . Bovendien laat je zien dat je maatschappelijk verantwoord onderneemt. Wat is lineair en circulair? Lineair gaat over producten die gemaakt, gebruikt en vervolgens weggegooid worden. Circulair gaat over maken, gebruiken en hergebruiken. Wat zijn de 10 R's van circulariteit? Refuse, Rethink, Reduce, Reuse, Repair, Refurbish, Remanufacture, Repurpose, Recycle en Recover. Deze 10 principes helpen bij het minimaliseren van afval en zorgen voor maximaal hergebruik van materialen. Lees meer over hoe KeyPro deze 10 principes integreert. Over KeyPro Wat gebeurt er met meubels na een huurperiode? Meubels gaan na inspectie terug in onze voorraad. Als een item beschadigd is, wordt het gerepareerd of gerefurbished. Daarna zijn ze weer zo goed als nieuw en kunnen ze weer ingezet worden voor nieuwe producten. Na een aantal ‘levens’, wanneer een meubel écht niet meer bruikbaar is, worden onderdelen gebruikt voor een zelfde kapotte versie. Het overige materiaal wordt dan gerecycled. Kan ik als opdrachtgever bijdragen aan de circulariteit van KeyPro? Zeker. Door meubels te huren in plaats van te kopen, voorkom je dat nieuwe grondstoffen worden gebruikt. Wat gebeurt er met meubels die niet meer verhuurbaar zijn? Deze krijgen vaak nóg een keer een leven via sociale projecten, donaties. Wanneer dat niet mogelijk is, zorgen we voor verantwoorde recycling van de materialen. Zijn alle meubels bij KeyPro circulair? Ja. We werken uitsluitend met meubels die geschikt zijn voor hergebruik en refurbish. Dit betekent dat ze stevig, repareerbaar en van duurzame materialen zijn gemaakt. Meer lezen?
